fields.description: Fern is an apartment phase within Central Park at City Walk, with one- to four-bedroom homes and two duplex penthouses. Its plans range from compact balcony apartments to large split-level layouts with service rooms and terraces. The park and activity spaces form part of the wider shared community.

overview: The penthouse plan has separate upper sleeping rooms and a lower guest room. The repeated area table describes the complete residence, not a second equal floor area to add to the total.
research.locationNote: At Central Park in City Walk, Dubai. The own phase brochure provides the location and shared park context. Views and access arrangements remain unit-specific.
research.priceNote: Property Finder displays about AED 1.9m as a selected-availability reference, while its legacy one-bedroom table begins near AED 1.8m and stock is marked unavailable. No current developer quote is established; the displayed reference is not a live offer.
research.paymentNote: The official original sheet gives 20% booking, 10% April 2023, 10% October 2023, 10% July 2024 and 50% July 2026 on handover. These historical dates do not establish a current unit balance or amended schedule.
research.handoverNote: Original official schedule: July 2026. Property Finder gives March 2026. Meraas lists Fern sold out and nearing handover; actual unit delivery remains unconfirmed.
